ns2:course.label: Music Theory and Practice I
ns2:course.description: Fundamental theory including terminology and notation; visual analysis of music elements, procedures, and forms; written applications in short projects. Credit is not given for both MUS 101 and MUS 103. Prerequisite: First-year students must complete Harmonia.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both MUS 101 and MUS 103. Prerequisite: First-year students must complete Harmonia.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
